errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No picture, or one that is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

url.description: Where its account's PDS serves it, for the body to link to.

blob.description: The picture as uploaded, to attach.

width.description: How wide it is drawn, in CSS pixels, as dev.knotless.defs#image's `width`: its pixels over the density a PNG says it was made at. Give it, and `height`, with the blob in `images`.

height.description: How high it is drawn, in CSS pixels.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it, whose pull, issue or comment will show it.

main.description: Uploads the body, a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, as a blob of the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless issue create --image` does: one over 1,000,000 bytes is drawn again as a JPEG that fits, at most 2000 pixels on its longest side. Its PDS keeps it only once a record attaches it: give it as one of dev.knotless.createIssue's, createPull's, createComment's or editItem's `images`, with a body linking to `url`. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Uploads a picture to show in a pull, an issue or a comment, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
